none: PAS NLM-C50F9B: Roman Coin fragment: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin fragment. Nummus of the House of Constantine, Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. With a crescentic break suggesting this coin comes from a disrupted group; more than one third of flan is lost. Obverse description: Bust right. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 14.5mm, Weight:…
